fields.Name: Example: Renewals by month
fields.Description: An aggregate for the example-chapter type (B24, D29): a chapter's member renewals by month, for one chapter. Granted to the staff type's spaces with ChapterID bound to the space's chapter anchor, so the server fills the chapter in and a caller never chooses it. An MJ query is not bound by row filters, so only the Integration role may run it directly; participants reach it through RunSpaceQuery alone. Its ChapterID parameter is extracted from the template by MJ's query save.
fields.SQL:
SELECT DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(m.RenewalDate), MONTH(m.RenewalDate), 1) AS Month, COUNT(*) AS Renewals
FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollabExamples].[ExampleChapterMember] m
WHERE m.ChapterID = {{ ChapterID | sqlString }} AND m.RenewalDate IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(m.RenewalDate), MONTH(m.RenewalDate), 1)
ORDER BY Month
